title: Replay settlement: after grant_scope_mismatch, read the retained grant's stored state from control-session-inspect details (begun vs expired vs overdue) instead of parking
outcome: When a replayed turn_begin is refused grant_scope_mismatch, TermAl reads the grant's stored state from Engram's additive control-session-inspect `details` and settles it: begun means applied; expired or superseded means never applied, so re-evaluate with a fresh grant; issued but overdue gets an explicit handling. The queue doesn't park as Waiting/Unknown for a manual cancel.
acceptance: Replay settlement: after grant_scope_mismatch, read the retained grant's stored state from control-session-inspect details (begun vs expired vs overdue) instead of parking is done
